reasoning_traces.think:
The primitives form a coherent mathematical framework where EPA serves as a foundational kernel for evaluating play impact, adjusted for opponent strength. Probability uncertainty ranking introduces stochasticity into predictions, enabling GSI to quantify confidence. Distribution drift detection ensures model robustness by identifying shifts in underlying data distributions. These operators interlink through shared probabilistic semantics—each relies on statistical inference and empirical validation. Failure modes include overfitting in EPA when opponent adjustment is insufficient, misalignment in uncertainty estimates due to poor calibration, and false positives in drift detection from noise. Dualities emerge in how uncertainty and drift both reflect model instability but through different axes: one temporal, one epistemic.
